title: American Water Advances Important Conversations at The Women's International Network of Utility Professionals 2026 International Conference
summary: American Water (NYSE: AWK), the largest regulated water and wastewater utility company in the U.S., adds to important discussions at the Women's International Network of Utility Professionals...
body_markdown:
CAMDEN, N.J.


, Sept. 23, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[American Water](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4781320-1&h=4181710237&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.amwater.com%2F&a=American+Water) (NYSE: AWK), the largest regulated water and wastewater utility company in the U.S., adds to important discussions at the Women's International Network of Utility Professionals (WiNUP) 2026 International Conference held September 20 to 23, 2026, in Indianapolis, Indiana.


WiNUP has been developing and recognizing professionals involved in utility business trends, issues, products and services since 1923. This year's conference theme: *Full Steam Ahead: Moving Forward and Preparing for the Future* brings together utility professionals from across the industry for learning, connection and inspiration.


American Water is proud to have two featured speakers:


**Lori Sutton, Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer, American Water** will join the *From Entry to Expert: Career Paths in the Utility Industry* panel. Lori will help spotlight the wide range of career opportunities across the utility industry and how American Water is developing the workforce of the future.


**Lynnae Wilson, Senior Vice President, Transformation Strategy and Execution, American Water** will participate in the *Resilient by Design: Leading Critical Infrastructure Into the Future* panel. Lynnae will speak to how American Water builds resilience into everyday planning, investment and operations. She will also provide practical advice for the next generation of infrastructure leaders.


American Water's leadership participation in the WiNUP International Conference supports our commitment to continual improvement through collaboration with leaders, regulators and key stakeholders on issues shaping the future of water and wastewater service.


For more information about WiNUP and for the 2026 International Conference's full agenda visit:[https://winup.org/content.aspx?page_id=22&club_id=537788&module_id=778497](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4781320-1&h=1871941179&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwinup.org%2Fcontent.aspx%3Fpage_id%3D22%26club_id%3D537788%26module_id%3D778497&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwinup.org%2Fcontent.aspx%3Fpage_id%3D22%26club_id%3D537788%26module_id%3D778497)


**About American Water**
American Water (NYSE: AWK) is the largest regulated water and wastewater utility company in the United States. With a history dating back to 1886 and celebrating 140 years in 2026, We Keep Life Flowing® by providing safe, clean, reliable and affordable drinking water and wastewater services to approximately 14 million people with regulated operations in 14 states and on 19 military installations. American Water's approximately 7,000 talented professionals leverage their significant expertise and the company's national size and scale to achieve excellent outcomes for the benefit of customers, employees, investors and other stakeholders.
